summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of moments.live B2B landing page across Desktop (1920px), Laptop (1440px), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (375px) viewports. All major features working correctly.

issues: Footer copyright text has very low opacity (0.2) and tagline has opacity 0.1 - intentionally subtle but may be hard to read for some users

context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working: Hero section with dashboard image, Problem section 2-column layout on desktop/single column on mobile, Dual Value toggle between Layer 1/Layer 2 with 'Explore Guest App' link navigation, Platform Features tab switching, How It Works 5-column grid on desktop, Business Case save/earn cards, Testimonials carousel with prev/next buttons and auto-rotation, Pricing 3-card grid with 'Most Popular' badge, Why Now 3-column layout, CTA section, Footer 4-column layout on desktop. Navbar shows hamburger menu below 1024px (lg breakpoint) and has scroll-triggered background blur. Guest App page (/guest-app) navigates correctly. No 'RASK' placeholder text found. All text readable.
